data.one_liner: Dart client library for accessing the HTTP API of the Typesense search engine.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart and Flutter client to connect and interact with the Typesense search engine HTTP API. Allows performing searches, managing collections, documents, synonyms, and other engine operations.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app that connects directly to a Typesense search backend.
You need to execute full-text search, filtering, and sorting queries against Typesense.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose HTTP client rather than a Typesense-specific API wrapper.
You are using a search engine other than Typesense.
strengths: Direct integration with Typesense search engine APIs.
Supports multi-node configurations, retries, and connection timeouts.
Actively updated with support for recent Typesense server features.
weaknesses: Still under development, meaning some APIs might change in future versions.
Exposing master API keys in user-facing apps is insecure; requires setting up search-only keys.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure a Client with your node addresses and API key.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making raw HTTP requests to the Typesense API without using a dedicated client library.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a powerful generic HTTP client for handling requests instead of the dedicated Typesense wrapper.
